metric_description: Request-throughput headroom against the 20% required buffer.
calculation_description: Current standard methodology for throughput headroom.

method_descriptions.peak_window: Headroom measured against peak observed throughput. Current standard.
method_descriptions.exclude_batch_windows: Excludes nightly batch windows from the peak calculation.

team_incentive: Bonus pool released if the metric is at or above target at end of the current period
methodology_change_policy: Method change requires Architecture Review Board approval per SRE handbook Section 8.4
note: Metric is short of target this period.
